purpose: Registry entries retracted after publication of the RQ3/RQ4 numbers, with cause. Kept as a separate applied-on-load file (not edited into the registry JSONs) so the originally published figures stay exactly reproducible via load_all(include_corrections=False).

retracted_mechanisms.mechanism_name: UNNAMED: AgentFuzzer (generic black-box fuzzing for IPI)
retracted_mechanisms.evidence: Rows 51, 57 and 59 are all arXiv 2505.05849, the same paper under three titles as it was renamed across versions (AgentFuzzer -> AgentVigil). Row 57 was already excluded by the 2026-08-17 dedup pass; row 59 was missed and remained screening=Include, so the paper contributed TWO RQ3 mechanism entries: 'AgentVigil' (row 51) and this one. Confirmed by downloading the row-59 PDF, which is arXiv 2505.05849v4 titled 'AgentVigil: Generic Black-Box Red-teaming for Indirect Prompt Injection against LLM Agents'.
retracted_mechanisms.effect: RQ3 mechanisms 183 -> 182. The retracted entry was uncovered while the canonical 'AgentVigil' is covered by 1 defense, so uncovered mechanisms 112 -> 111 and the never-defended share 61.2% -> 61.0%. Covered count unchanged at 71.

This is a removal for a PIPELINE limitation, not a property of the papers: 21 of the 26 excluded papers are IEEE/paywalled venues against 3 on arXiv, and 20 of 26 are Security track against 59% in the corpus, so the exclusion carries a venue and track bias that must be disclosed wherever the resulting counts are used.
